activity_budget_ticket.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Hanoi Vietnam low cost paid attraction entrance ticket two adult tickets price
activity_budget_ticket.reason: The exact Hanoi page listed attraction prices such as Puppet Theater and Hanoi Hilton Entrance, but the snippets did not state an adult/two-ticket party basis or an unambiguous named currency, and the values were not explicitly suitable for two adult tickets. The low-cost ticket anchor therefore failed closed.

activity_mid_half_day.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Hanoi Vietnam half day group activity tour duration price
activity_mid_half_day.reason: The permitted Budget Your Trip search exposed $5 half-day private walking-tour snippets and separate $5 small-group tour snippets, but no single exact-city row stated both a half-day duration and group basis. Private-tour prices without party identity were rejected.

activity_high_full_day.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Hanoi Vietnam full day premium activity tour duration price
activity_high_full_day.reason: The permitted search returned a Standard/Luxury Ha Long Bay cruise at $33 without an explicit duration, and multi-day tour results without a single full-day duration. No exact-city full-day premium activity with duration and premium basis was accepted.
